reviewer: radial_coefficient_bound, independent of authors of all four reviewed modules
review_scope: All four complete source bodies; all ten expanded declarations and every axiom report; receipt integrity and unchanged source/object hashes. Exact finite coefficient norm, coordinate-product construction, homogeneity dependence, degree zero and empty variable types.
reasoning: The evaluation bound uses the actual polynomial support sum and replaces each supported monomial exponent sum by the advertised homogeneous degree. It neither assumes its conclusion nor changes n to n+1.

The word existence helper selects a list representing the actual exponent multiset. The length equality is proved from Finsupp.card_toMultiset. The same chosen word works for every evaluation z; commutativity is explicit.

The coordinate multilinear map is a literal product of coordinate projections, with the operator norm bound derived pointwise from norm_le_pi_norm and finite products. Its diagonal is the actual coordinate product.

The homogeneous representation chooses a word separately for each actual support element and takes the coefficient-scaled finite sum. The diagonal identity and norm bound then follow directly. No permutation symmetry of L is claimed; no symmetry assumption is needed for its diagonal representation.

The evaluation theorem permits arbitrary variable types. The multilinear operator-norm theorem explicitly requires Fintype for the ordinary finite Pi norm. It does not silently claim the same norm statement for a different spatial norm.
The word selection and multilinear existence are mathematical, noncomputable representations. Source comments accurately disclose choice and make no executable implementation or complexity claim.

cases: constant polynomial at radius zero with empty Fin0 coordinate type
zero-arity multilinear representation of an arbitrary constant on empty coordinates
empty exponent word for the zero exponent family
zero polynomial representation for every degree and arbitrary finite variable type
boundary_checks.interpretation: Four example proofs compile against the actual APIs. Degree zero uses the empty product value one, so constants are retained. For an empty coordinate type and positive homogeneous degree, the support restriction forces a homogeneous polynomial to be zero; the finite-support construction therefore asks for no impossible positive-length empty-type word.
boundary_checks.disclosure: These are supplemental compiled API boundary checks, not new named theorem milestones. One development compile fixed an explicit Mathlib isHomogeneous_zero parameter application. No defect in the reviewed source was found.

trust: All ten reviewed declarations have only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound in their complete axiom reports.
environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0-rc2 development objects reused. No source dependency rebuild or general reproducibility conclusion is claimed.
limits: This focused review is not a proof of analytic convergence, physical KS identification, implementation correctness, full Theorem T or a broad audit of unrelated dependencies.
